html:
Lome, a coastal town on the border with the Gold Coast, became the capital of German Togoland in 1897, replacing Aneho.

German traders were drawn by its position near British territory, where goods could be smuggled without duty. A wharf (1904) and railways inland made it the colony's port, and later a deep-water port opened in 1968. Lome is now the capital of Togo, its largest city and a main port for Burkina Faso, Niger and Mali. Its Grand Marche was the base of the Nana Benz cloth traders, and it gave its name to the Lome Convention of 1975 between Europe and its former colonies.
sum: Lome, a coastal town on the border with the Gold Coast, became the capital of German Togoland in 1897, replacing Aneho.
